question: Does local destination enumeration (A2 dossier) clear the campaign admission gate (>= 5% removable complete-job service, or demonstrated memory-capacity bottleneck) when measured against the CURRENT selected source (A1-screened HEAD)?

source_pin.note: A2I changed no production source; the only worktree change is this evidence directory (untracked at measurement time)

gate.definition: minimum_removable_fraction 0.05 (campaign.json admission_gate policy constant), removable complete-job service measured on the current selected implementation
gate.capacity_route: not exercised: A2 transients are bounded by the dossier design (touched-ID buffer + candidate index, both << scope array); no memory-capacity bottleneck claimed

instrument.site: venvs/a1r_cand_wheel (site receipt verified in-run by the probe's identity leg)

protocol.stat: min-of-reps per origin, median across origins

superseded_run_disclosure.defect: its printed removable_end_to_end_* figures carry a sign-label defect: net_share (negative when the candidate route saves) was multiplied directly, so the printed values are the negations of the true removable fractions; the corrected values are in a2i_access_rerun.json
superseded_run_disclosure.status: kept on disk append-only; its validation legs (bitwise identity, sentinel, exclusions, ULP, signature census, H05 crosscheck) were all green and remain corroborating, but its removable figures are superseded by a2i_access_rerun.json

HOLDOUT_r1200.h05_in_radius_crosscheck: skipped (H05 probe captured the radius-500 cell only)

measured_coverage.note: sentinel-mechanism coverage is enormous in both cells (>99% of the destination adjust/filter scan avoidable per engaged origin) - the failure is COST, not coverage

derivation_notes: net_kernel_share is (candidate_side - dense_side)/dense_side per origin (candidate side = tracked search + enumeration + candidate-tail metric; dense side = plain search + dense-tail adjust), median across the 32 sampled origins; the removable share is its negation
end-to-end vs measured wall: removable_kernel_share * acc_stage_wall_at_HEAD / (B0 non-access stages + acc wall at HEAD), all in the run's own session
end-to-end vs A1-derived: removable_kernel_share * (A1R warm cand median - B0 non-access stages) / A1R warm cand median; session-coupled derivation, spread disclosed in A1R raws
each cell's arithmetic uses ONLY that cell's capture and session; no share is transferred across cells

verdict.reason: realized removable complete-job service is below the 0.05 gate in BOTH observed access cells: ACCESS r500 0.030166 (A1-derived leg) / 0.012568 (measured-wall leg); HOLDOUT r1200 0.000456 / 0.000220. The ACCESS cell is additionally ceiling-limited: the whole accessibility stage is only 0.039391 of that window at HEAD (measured wall 0.092505 s), so even perfect removal cannot clear 5% there. In the HOLDOUT cell the mechanism's saving collapses with radius: per-origin tracking cost scales with the touched-label count (median A 530 at r1200 vs 73 at r500), and the candidate side barely beats the dense side (median net -21.5 ns)
verdict.recorded_coverage_and_bound: measured per DECISION for not-admitted experiments: full coverage and cost tables above, per-origin rows in the two records
verdict.consequence: source left unchanged; no A2 implementation, no A2 candidate at I00; no production benchmark consumed by this experiment
verdict.design_budget: the dossier's one design/revision budget is consumed by this measurement; A2 is closed as not-admitted unless the principal reopens scope

lease.charging: all A2I probe fires are diagnostics-class: window-stamped and lease-logged, uncharged, gate_eligible false

open_routing_flag: A2R (#29) scope is now h04's call: with no A2 candidate, the review target is this not-admitted disposition (records + unchanged source), and the screen leg has no candidate to screen
